profile.headline: Creating technology solutions for our community.
profile.summary: A lean thinker seeking to leverage my skills in analysis and computer science to bring creative technology solutions to solve business problems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Develop web applications using React.js & Node.js
- CI/CD Pipeline for code management using GitLab
- Deploy applications to Amazon Web Services
Implemented Renovate Bot which managed packages and dependencies for 20+ applications.
- Created and implemented CI/CD Pipeline Gitlab template.
- Migrated apps between Kubernetes clusters and coordinated switchover to organize infrastructure.
- Created tertiary environments for existing apps to allow for testing in 13 different dev environments.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
- Architected and developed smallneighborhood.com, a React app hosted on AWS using a serverless backend with DynamoDB and Lambda Functions.
- Developed CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments of 20+ websites on CloudFront and S3.
- Published business dashboard Android app on Google Play Store and as a progressive web app.
- Created an admin application for instant business and customer updates and invoicing.

positions.title: Co Founder
positions.description:
--Started up a local business for gamers.
Set up shared hard-disk server that stored game files.
Set up networking, firewall policy to minimize legacy.
Troubleshooting and problem solving issue while operation.
Recorded expenses, make Net Profit/Loss to file yearly tax.
Consulted for other start-up to open their own gaming center.
Created games and automated software to optimize user’s experience.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Completed competitive and intensive program with 1000+ hours of training in  4 months.
- Developed ADHDmyway app using Ionic framework and hosted it on AWS utilizing Cognito for authorization, S3 for file storage, and DynamoDB for data storage. Made the app serverless using Lambda functions through an API Gateway.
- Collaborated with a team in an Agile environment; administered group tasks and managed team productivity in order to ensure successful execution of our projects..
